fable.w: This is a bare appropriation of additional funds for salaries and expenses. It involves no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue involving any party outside the federal government; there is no tempting participation reading here.
fable.s: For an additional amount for “Salaries and expenses”, $1,450,000.

qwen_block.w: This section is a simple appropriation of funds for salaries and expenses. It does not establish any process for consultation, coordination, or input from outside parties (such as the public, states, or experts) before a federal decision is made. It is purely a funding provision.
qwen_block.s: For an additional amount for “Salaries and expenses”, $1,450,000.

opus.w: This section only appropriates an additional $1,450,000 for salaries and expenses. It sets up no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body, or right to sue. Like Example 1, it just authorizes funding, so no outside party takes part in any federal decision.
opus.b: This section is only an appropriation. It adds money to a "Salaries and expenses" account. No one is consulted, no hearing or comment period is required, and no outside party is involved in any decision. The only tempting reading would be to treat any funding provision as procedural, but nothing here involves anyone outside the federal government.

qwen_chat.w: This section is a simple appropriations clause authorizing funds for internal government salaries and expenses. It does not involve any consultation, coordination, or interaction with parties outside the federal government. Therefore, it does not meet the definition of participation.
qwen_chat.s: For an additional amount for “Salaries and expenses”, $1,450,000.
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that "salaries and expenses" implies hiring people, and thus participation. However, this is a standard appropriations clause for internal agency operations. There is no mention of outside parties, advisory boards, public comment, or consultation with non-federal entities. The funds are for the government's own internal staffing and operational costs.
